basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 3-bath home offering nearly 3,000 sqft of refined living space in one of San Francisco's most desirable coastal communities. Bathed in natural light, the home showcases graceful archways, and original period details that add warmth and character throughout. The main level hosts four well-appointed bedrooms and a newly renovated full bathroom. The lower level is a world of its own  featuring a full family room, a second and third full bath, ample storage, and a serene primary suite. From here, discover the sunroom that opens to a private backyard outfitted with a patio and raised garden beds  perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or cultivating your own urban garden. A spacious laundry room and 1-car garage complete the home's generous footprint. Conveniently located just moments from the vibrant Geary and Clement corridors, indulge in a variety of dining, shopping, and daily conveniences including Andronico's Community Market a block away. Nature lovers will appreciate being minutes from Lincoln Park Golf Course, the Legion of Honor, Ocean Beach, and Golden Gate Park. Access to public transit and major thoroughfares makes this home an ideal blend of tranquility and city convenience.
